_meta.description: Engine rule parameters that are numbers, kept out of code (CLAUDE.md). Each one is a proposed default until the open question that owns it is settled.

highInterestThresholdPercent.meaning: Debts with a nominal rate above this get surplus in step 2 of the savings waterfall, before any account.

assumedWorkStartAge.meaning: For the Social Security estimate, years from this age through the year before the plan date are back-filled at the plan-year covered earnings when no ssa.gov record is entered.

emergencyReserveMonths.meaning: Months of that year's spending kept in cash. A shortfall draws cash above the reserve first and the reserve itself last, after Roth. Level 2 will replace the flat 6 months with the Rule of 5 target.

penaltyFreeAge.meaning: M1 applies the penalty when age at year end is below this, so the year a person turns 59 is penalized and the year they turn 60 is not.
